rule: correlation 0.9 or more: agree closely; 0.7 to 0.9: agree broadly; below 0.7: weak agreement; fewer than 5 places: too few to judge.

pairs.differsOnPurpose: Different years and grid sizes: the pattern should agree, not every millimetre.
pairs.caveat: GSMaP covers 60 S to 60 N only, so polar sites are left out.

note: Independent partner-agency data (JAXA) agrees with the NASA values we score with: yearly rain (correlation 0.975 over 40 places) and vegetation index (correlation 0.992 over 43 places). Within our own data, site and grid values agree where the scale allows it; the pairs that differ on purpose (a site against its 55 km cell) are listed with the reason. Pairs with fewer than 5 places are marked too few to judge, and the Moon and Mars checks are spot checks on a handful of targets.
